tourSettingsDescription: A quick walkthrough of subscriptions, servers and connecting.
tour_welcome_description: I'm {name}, your digital guide. Let's explore the app together. You can close this tutorial anytime and find it again in Settings.
tour_navigation_description: Use this panel to navigate between the app's sections.
tour_connections_description: See which apps are connecting to which destinations, how much traffic they transfer and how it is routed. Use search and filters to find a connection, open its details or close it when needed.
tour_profiles_description: Add the subscription URL from your provider or import a local Clash / Mihomo YAML file. Select the profile you want to use. You can do this after the tutorial.
tour_proxies_description: Your profile?s proxy groups and servers appear here. Once connected, test their latency and select a server in the group you need. An empty list means a profile still needs to be added or the core started.
tour_capture_description: System proxy works with apps that follow the system proxy settings. TUN captures more application traffic and requires Administrator privileges. Choose the mode that suits you in Settings.
tour_connect_description: After adding a profile and choosing a capture mode, press the power button to start the VPN. Press it again to disconnect. The overview shows your connection status and session traffic.
tour_routing_description: Rules mode follows your profile?s routing rules. Global mode sends traffic through the selected global proxy. These buttons switch the core?s routing mode.
tour_finish_description: This card in Settings restarts the tutorial whenever you need it. I?ll follow your theme?s accent color. Add your subscription when you?re ready ? see you around!
